summary: Implemented the feature without running tests or flake8, and without committing. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler reduced to thin adapters over the savers and plot function; write_nifti default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; docs/source/data.rst gained csv_saver and nifti_saver entries; five test files added or updated (test_csv_saver, test_nifti_saver, test_handler_segmentation_saver, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image, and test_handler_classification_saver with filename). Unverified: test execution, ignite 0.3.0 attach behavior, and flake8 compliance (checked by reading only).
